notes: Corrected the article of shemen ha-qodesh: the single written the goes to the article on the rectum and shemen keeps only oil. Rule 29 permits a supplied the on a construct noun only where no article morpheme is present, and rule 47 states that a present article takes the English the before a supplied one even where the head noun is a construct that could take no article of its own. The the also stands directly before holy, the rectum's word, so the fronting and arthrous counts converge.
The correction brings this phrase into line with ha-kohen ha-gadol in the same verse, where the written the already goes to the article on kohen and the agreement article on gadol is unrepresented.
The three-morpheme whither unit was checked for atomicity and retained: one English word carries the relative, the resumptive adverb and the directive he (rules 22, 30).
The hand/avenger/blood chain writes two the's for one article, so the article takes the fronted one and the outer construct takes the second supplied one (rule 29).
